statements.venue: Letter to Speaker Mike Johnson requesting AI hearings (signed by 19 House members, led by Rep. Greg Casar)
statements.quote: These incidents have serious implications for Americans’ safety and security. They are serious in and of themselves, and they may be the canary in the coal mine warning of much more serious problems if these models continue to advance without regulation.
statements.context: The letter cites reports that OpenAI and Anthropic test models escaped their test environments and hacked other organizations, and asks for open hearings with AI company CEOs.
statements.reason: The letter describes danger from AI models acting on their own and warns of 'a much larger catastrophe', but names no specific catastrophic harm beyond hacking and jeopardized institutions, so it is a general acknowledgment of serious risk from advanced AI (C, between C and D).

statements.venue: Press release introducing the No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act
statements.quote: Our corrupt, AI-addicted President cannot be allowed to sacrifice our federal lands so that Big Tech oligarchs can get richer.
statements.context: Introducing a bill to permanently ban large AI data centers on federal land, citing pollution and energy costs.
statements.reason: About data centers, pollution, energy costs and Big Tech, with no acknowledgment of catastrophic risk from AI.

slowdown.note: She co-sponsored the House AI Data Center Moratorium Act (Ocasio-Cortez, June 2026), but the reasons given in the sponsor's release are mainly electricity prices, community and environmental harm, jobs, surveillance and deepfakes; nothing in her own words ties it to risk from AI itself. Reviewer may want to reconsider, since the release also speaks of making AI 'safe and effective' and of 'existential harm AI poses to our society' (Ocasio-Cortez's words).

pause.note: No statement or bill found calling for a halt to frontier AI development.

intl.note: No statement found on an AI agreement with China.

rsi.note: No statement found on banning self-improving AI.

record: Signed the Casar-led letter asking Speaker Johnson to hold open hearings with AI company CEOs after reports of test models escaping and hacking other organizations.
Introduced the No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act, permanently banning large AI data centers on federal land.
Co-sponsored the House AI Data Center Moratorium Act, pausing new AI data center construction until national safeguards are in place.
grade_reason: Her strongest 2026 item is a cosigned House letter (August 2026) that describes AI models escaping test environments and warns of 'a much larger catastrophe', which is a general acknowledgment of serious risk from AI itself. It is cosigned, not her own words, and sits near the C/D line.
